name: SI lambda deploy size fix — separate lambda jar (2026-09-03)
description: SI lambda deploy (inttra2_qa_lambda_si_es_stream / inttra2_qa_lambda_si_s3) fails UpdateFunctionCode 'Unzipped size must be smaller than 262144000 bytes' after ION-16396 SI AWS SDK v2 (cloud-sdk) upgrade. Full app shaded jar grew past 250MB. Replicate booking approach: add shade-lambda execution producing a slim shipping-instruction-lambdas jar + update build.sh. Document at shipping-instruction/docs/2026-09-03-si-lambda-size-refactor.md.

entries.summary: Chosen fix: replicate booking approach — add shade-lambda execution producing slim shipping-instruction-lambdas jar + build.sh move line; deploy job points SI lambdas at that jar
entries.detail: Booking (build.sh + pom shade-lambda, ION-14382) produces a second classifier=lambdas shaded jar (booking-lambdas-1.0.jar -> Booking-Lambdas-${RELEASE}.jar) with aggressive artifactSet excludes; its shade-lambda even targets the same S3ArchiveHandler/IndexerHandler. Reusing booking's validated exclude set for SI. KEEP (required by the two SI handlers): cloud-sdk-api, cloud-sdk-aws (Dynamo Enhanced, StorageClient/S3, Jest module), org.elasticsearch (Indexer uses QueryBuilders/BoolQueryBuilder/SearchSourceBuilder + Jest io.searchbox), aws-lambda-java-events, aws-java-sdk-dynamodb v1 (AttributeValue/OperationType event model), Jackson+Joda, logback/slf4j, commons-lang3, AWS v2 dynamodb/s3/auth/regions, and CRITICALLY software.amazon.awssdk:apache-client (cloud-sdk DynamoDbClientConfig uses ApacheHttpClient — excluding it => NoClassDefFoundError, per PI). EXCLUDE server-only/heavy: aws-crt(+native), netty-nio-client, ssm, sesv2, sso/ssooidc, s3-transfer-manager, sqs-extended, mysql, jetty/dropwizard/jersey/hk2, swagger, POI/xmlbeans, hibernate-validator, hystrix/rxjava/archaius, javers, log4j, testng, sqlite4java; plus SI-only server deps: Oracle ojdbc10, dropwizard-jdbi3/jdbi3, AWS v2 cloudformation. No source changes needed (no lambda class imports excluded server packages). Not committing until user confirms Jira ticket/branch.

entries.summary: Root cause: SI full app shaded jar grew past Lambda 250MB unzipped limit after ION-16396 AWS SDK v2 (cloud-sdk) upgrade; both SI lambdas deploy the full app jar
entries.detail: SI Deploy job (release 26.08.001) fails: UpdateFunctionCode InvalidParameterValueException 'Unzipped size must be smaller than 262144000 bytes'. Two SI lambdas both deploy the single full app jar: inttra2_qa_lambda_si_es_stream (handler com.inttra.mercury.shippinginstruction.lambda.IndexerHandler::handle, java17) and inttra2_qa_lambda_si_s3 (S3ArchiveHandler::handle). Last good deploy 25.03.010 had CodeSize=92,773,633 (zipped ~88MB). ION-16396 replaced lean AWS SDK v1 with cloud-sdk-aws aggregate (AWS SDK 2.x s3/dynamodb + HTTP clients incl aws-crt native + transitive v1) pushing unzipped over 262144000. deploy_*.sh use CodeS3Key=LAMBDA_CODE_PATH placeholder substituted by Jenkins deploy job; build.sh currently produces only shipping-instruction-1.0.jar (the DW app jar). Same problem/pattern as PI (session 3c7a312e0d9a42b2, pi-bl-es-lambda) and booking (fixed under ION-14382).

entries.summary: Gap confirmed: SI Lambda handlers were migrated under ION-16396 (commit 588c531b85) but were NOT documented in any SI AWS-upgrade design/analysis doc — the in-module lambdas + 250MB constraint were outside the documented blast radius
entries.detail: The two SI Lambda handlers WERE migrated to cloud-sdk as part of commit 588c531b85 'ION-16396: shipping-instruction AWS SDK 2.x (cloud-sdk) upgrade' (S3ArchiveHandler -> StorageClient/S3, IndexerHandler/HandlerSupport -> DynamoDbClientConfig + JestModule). HOWEVER none of the SI AWS-upgrade design/analysis docs mention them: grep (case-insensitive) for lambda|IndexerHandler|S3ArchiveHandler|handler|indexer|archive|stream|StorageClient|si_es_stream|si_s3 across shipping-instruction/docs/{2026-07-30-si-aws-upgrade-design.md, 2026-08-18-si-aws-upgrade.md, 2026-08-18-si-aws-upgrade-confluence-design.md, 2026-09-03-si-es-query-latency-issue.md} returned zero matches. So the module's two in-module Lambda deployables and their separate 250MB packaging constraint were never captured in the upgrade blast-radius analysis — the same blind spot as PI (pi-bl-es-lambda). Context from user: SI Lambdas are unusual (most modules keep lambdas in the dedicated lambda module or as CFN scripts; booking was thought the only in-module outlier). In dev the Lambda trigger is disabled, and in higher envs the functions had not been updated for a long time (QA function LastModified 2025-04-10, release 25.03.010) — so 26.08 is the first update attempt since the upgrade and it failed at UpdateFunctionCode on size, which also explains new subscriptions/SIs not being indexed into ES -> not flowing to cargo visibility.

entries.summary: Implemented booking-style fix: shade-lambda execution in SI pom + build.sh move line producing SI-Lambdas-${RELEASE}.jar; deploy job (out-of-repo) must repoint the two SI lambdas at the slim jar
entries.detail: Two in-repo changes on shipping-instruction (mirroring booking ION-14382). (1) shipping-instruction/pom.xml: added a 'shade-lambda' execution BEFORE 'shade-main' in maven-shade-plugin (v3.5.3). shade-lambda: finalName shipping-instruction-lambdas-${project.version}, shadedArtifactAttached=true, shadedClassifierName=lambdas, createDependencyReducedPom=false, ServicesResourceTransformer (merges META-INF/services — required by AWS SDK v2 ServiceLoader), artifactSet/excludes for sqlite4java, aws-crt(+crt), netty-nio-client/io.netty, ssm, sesv2, sns, sso/ssooidc, s3-transfer-manager, cloudformation, sqs-extended, oracle ojdbc10, dropwizard-jdbi3/jdbi, mysql, jetty/dropwizard/jersey/hk2, swagger, POI/xmlbeans, hibernate, hystrix/rxjava/archaius, javers, uom, rholder, testng, log4j; plus filters for non-linux JNI natives + fonts + META-INF signatures. shade-main unchanged (still ships full app jar with SIApplication mainClass). Ordering matters: shade-lambda first so both executions shade the ORIGINAL unshaded artifact. (2) shipping-instruction/build.sh: added `mv ${app_dir}/target/shipping-instruction-lambdas-1.0.jar ${bld_dir}/SI-Lambdas-${RELEASE}.jar` so the slim jar lands in out/docker_build/app alongside SI-${RELEASE}.jar. NO source changes (no lambda class imports excluded server packages). REMAINING external step (out-of-repo, Jenkins): the SI Lambda deploy job must point CodeS3Key/LAMBDA_CODE_PATH for si_es_stream and si_s3 at SI-Lambdas-${RELEASE}.jar instead of SI-${RELEASE}.jar (booking made the analogous deploy-job change). Not committed yet — awaiting user confirmation of Jira ticket/branch.

entries.summary: Validated: new shipping-instruction-lambdas jar = 171MB unzipped (79MB under 250MB limit) vs full app jar 333.3MB (83.3MB over); 1127/1127 tests pass; handlers + all required libs (incl apache-client) present
entries.detail: mvn -q package -P mercury-commons -pl shipping-instruction: BUILD SUCCESS, surefire 1127 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped. Produced two shaded jars in shipping-instruction/target: (1) shipping-instruction-1.0.jar (full DW app) = 135.9MB zipped / 349,453,121 B (333.3MB) unzipped => 83.3MB OVER the 262,144,000 (250MB) Lambda limit — reproduces the exact deploy failure; (2) NEW shipping-instruction-lambdas-1.0.jar (classifier lambdas) = 72.3MB zipped / 179,291,148 B (171MB) unzipped => 79MB UNDER the limit. Lambda jar content verified: KEEPS IndexerHandler, S3ArchiveHandler, cloud-sdk StorageClient, io.searchbox JestClient, org.elasticsearch QueryBuilders, AWS v2 apache-client (48 classes), AWS v2 dynamodb, lucene, elasticsearch. Big offenders REMOVED (0 present): Oracle ojdbc10, aws-crt(+native ~44MB unzipped), io.netty, AWS v2 cloudformation. Residual inert (~4-5MB): web-server stack org.eclipse.jetty (231), io.dropwizard (161), org.glassfish.jersey (153) survive artifactSet wildcard excludes because they resolve via multiple in-house aggregates (commons/cloud-sdk-api/cloud-sdk-aws) — same multi-path 'whack-a-mole' PI documented; harmless (never instantiated by handlers) and jar is well under limit. Probe proof: POI/xmlbeans/hibernate/hystrix/rxjava/javers/swagger/log4j all 0 (either excluded or not present in SI tree).

entries.summary: INT boot checks: caught a real NoClassDefFoundError (jetty) in the slim jar's IndexerHandler; DW app jar boots fully to listening Jetty; after fix, lambda handlers instantiate + live DynamoDB DescribeTable succeeds
entries.detail:
Ran INT sanity boot checks with AWS SSO creds (account 081020446316 = inttra_int), exporting the SSO session into AWS_* env vars (mirrors the Lambda IAM-role env-var creds; required because the slim jar excludes sso/ssooidc). LAMBDA: a standalone LambdaBootCheck.java compiled against the slim jar instantiated S3ArchiveHandler() and IndexerHandler() and ran a live DynamoDbClient.describeTable('inttra_int_si') via ApacheHttpClient -> status=ACTIVE itemCount=115. FIRST ATTEMPT FAILED: IndexerHandler.<init> threw java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: org/eclipse/jetty/io/RuntimeIOException (the Jest/AWS request-signing path references it; class lives in jetty-io-12.1.12.jar, which my org.eclipse.jetty:* exclude had stripped). S3ArchiveHandler (DynamoDB+S3 only) was unaffected, which is why unit tests (full classpath) and size checks did not catch it — an actual boot check was required. DW: `java -jar shipping-instruction-1.0.jar check conf/int/config.yaml` -> 'Configuration is OK' (exercises ${awsps} SSM param substitution via creds); `server conf/int/config.yaml` -> booted SIApplication end-to-end (Jersey+admin handlers, Jest/ES client AWS-signed, DynamoDB enhanced repos for inttra_int_si/inttra_int_siDraft) and bound Jetty 8080/8081 (connectors bind last => full run() success); stopped by PID.</detail>

entries.summary: PR #1237 review comment (lambda jar filename) assessed INVALID: finalName sets on-disk name (verified ...-lambdas-1.0.jar exists), 1.0 is static ${project.version} not ${RELEASE}; reviewer's fix would break the build. No change; drafted reply.
entries.detail: git-svc-code-review (svc_git_e2codereview_rw) commented on PR #1237 that build.sh's `mv shipping-instruction-lambdas-1.0.jar` is wrong: (a) claims shade produces shipping-instruction-lambdas-1.0-lambdas.jar because shadedClassifierName=lambdas, and (b) suggests using ${RELEASE} instead of hard-coded 1.0. ASSESSMENT: comment is INVALID (confirmed with user). Evidence: (a) target/ after build contains shipping-instruction-lambdas-1.0.jar (plus shade's original- backup) and NO -lambdas-suffixed file — when <finalName> is set it defines the on-disk name; shadedClassifierName only tags the attached Maven artifact metadata, it does not suffix the file. The boot check + size checks all ran against shipping-instruction-lambdas-1.0.jar successfully. (b) 1.0 is the static Maven ${project.version} (repo-wide: every module is version 1.0); the shade finalName is shipping-instruction-lambdas-${project.version} -> ...-1.0.jar. ${RELEASE} is the Jenkins release number (e.g. 26.08.001) used ONLY for the destination SI-Lambdas-${RELEASE}.jar. Adopting the suggested mv shipping-instruction-lambdas-${RELEASE}.jar would reference a non-existent ...-26.08.001.jar and, under set -e, break the build — i.e. the fix introduces the very bug it warns about. Matches booking precedent (ION-14382): mv booking-lambdas-1.0.jar -> Booking-Lambdas-${RELEASE}.jar with the same finalName/classifier config. Decision: NO code change; provided a ready-to-paste reviewer reply. If project version ever becomes dynamic the correct token is ${project.version}, not ${RELEASE}.
